runtime_registration.preflight: preflight.install(provider); provider.read(obligation=...) returns Facts(evidence=G1 eligibility, participation_eligible, attendance_eligible, project_eligible, event_active, owner_active, retained_only=False). Nonlocking canonical retained-data read only. Unavailable Events reader returns preserved Facts with retained_only=True; explicit finance acknowledgement is then required.
runtime_registration.dashboard: dashboard.install(pool_reader); pool_reader(makerspace_id=...) supplies domain-owned money metrics
runtime_registration.scanner: scan_policy.install(shared_policy_reader): query-free existing shared scanner configuration -> ScannerPolicy(backend, host, port); absent or unhealthy fails 503, explicit backend none records skipped. No second finance scan switch.

retention_registration: apps.payments.event_payouts.retention_registration.providers() returns callable retained adapters; G registers in always-present core ready and shared registries.

source_boundaries.validation: attachment_processing.process holds source boundary across external I/O, releases DB transaction/row locks before I/O
source_boundaries.cleanup: cleanup.delete_one: deployment recovery NORMAL only, FK-free coordination independent of tenant/source
source_boundaries.fanout: tasks.page persistent keyset cursor advances even on failed/frozen/held subjects
source_boundaries.crypto: transactions.prepared_scope takes source lock-only boundary, prepares shared tenant keys outside atomic, then wraps account/global/tenant fences and host/authority/obligation locks.
source_boundaries.direct_retention_task: tasks.run_due_retention_task queued after hold release; same retained source/fences and recovery NORMAL checks.
